decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in the rear garden and internal alterations to the second floor bathroom of the house, as shown on drawing numbers 454-201, 454-202 and 454-004, received 5 September 2006, are satisfactory, as the development would not affect the architectural and historic significance of the listed building. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policy ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in rear garden and internal alterations to second floor of house
